scope: Independent mathematical and literal-source review of UCE10-UCE17. UCE1-UCE9 are read as preceding proved interfaces rather than independently reviewed here. The final GdEnd-to-automorphy assembly is outside this focused review; GdEnd existence is not inferred.
findings: UCE10: Every group element has a positive power in the supplied finite-index subgroup. Algebraicity of eigenvalues and coefficients follows without a prime-to-characteristic index assumption. An algebraic element of a local domain over the finite field with a prescribed residue is that constant, since its nonzero difference would be invertible in the finite constant subfield. On H the matrix of a group power is the ordinary matrix power.

UCE11: Normalization and the disconnected transpose identity give zeta*diag(1,0,-1), with zeta a unit and three distinct eigenvalues in every characteristic different from two. Stable subspaces are coordinate subspaces; pairing each forced zero with its antidiagonal transpose gives exactly upper, lower, full irreducible, or isolated-middle/outer-block alternatives. In an irreducible block the marked projectors and paths in the entry graph produce all matrix units. The trace Gram matrix of actual group-matrix basis elements is nonsingular over the fraction field and has constant-field entries, whereas its residue factors through diagonal matrices. This contradicts its rank in characteristic three as well, without dividing by n or n!. The diagonal and disconnected-component assertions follow from the constant-field argument.

UCE12: The single original FinEnd subgroup precedes every later U and S. Every test map is an actual ordinary point by UCE5; killing the coefficient maximal ideal gives the finite residue-field action required by ConstOfChar. The triangular alternative kills all chosen deviations of one sign. The preceding original FinCrit supplier gives finite S0, and the actual weight-zero entry subalgebra is an O-submodule of that finite module. Noetherianity gives literal FinA with the same marked element.

UCE13: Weight-zero polynomial truncations in the actual entry deviations lie in the original weightZeroSubalgebra. FinA makes it compact and hence closed in Hausdorff S, giving equality with S0. The finite monomial presentations show that the actual entry algebra equals the direct sum of the homogeneous parts, not the full completed ring. Finite-module quotient compactness gives the required topology comparison, including torsion and nonreduced rings.

UCE14: Integrality of finite S0 and nilpotence of its maximal ideal modulo pi force positive valuation of each nonempty balanced monomial. For positive/negative generator pairs this gives the strict inequality -b_i/a_i < -b_j/a_j. One rational slope makes all nonzero generator images strictly small; zero-weight, one-sided and zero-image cases are covered. The initial algebra map is not assumed local or continuous.

UCE15: One finite field contains every chosen generator value and the images of a finite O-module generating set of S0. Its ring of integers is an actual complete finite coefficient DVR inside the supplied algebraic closure. Evaluation agrees on each homogeneous piece because that piece is a finite O-module with the proved subspace topology. The homogeneous kernel is killed weight by weight, and uniform q^degree decay permits regrouping all formal terms. The resulting local map on completed S agrees on every original entry-algebra element.

UCE16: The pushed representation is an actual OrdPt over that finite coefficient DVR with the same g1 and B. Its entries equal torus conjugation on both components because theta(T(t))=T(t). The equality is of full group homomorphisms, not only traces or semisimplifications. The literal exists_ordPt_of_point target is preserved for arbitrary xi and every actual IsPush realization.

UCE17: Passing to the normal core preserves every-open-subgroup scope. A powered inertia element with cyclotomic value 1+ell supplies three distinct eigenvalues in that core. The finite-index restriction argument leaves only the scalar case or three transitive character lines if reducible; the former is excluded by those eigenvalues. The ordinary basis diagonalizes that element by an upper triangular change, so the residual separator acts with trivial permutation. A three-cycle forces trace(g*x^m)=0; the equations for m=0,1,2 contradict b^2!=1 as displayed. This is the literal MatIrr statement without a new small-prime guard or restriction only to the cyclotomic kernel.
